svg.title: Blueprint BP-01, system flow. 1 Request. Decide first: broken goes to rescue mode, a question or fix gets a direct answer in steps, a feature gets its safety parts named, a new app goes to risk triage. 2 Risk triage: Green, Amber or Red, more risk means more care. 3 One-screen plan you approve. 4 Build loop: save point, explain_changes.py, one change, proof, update PROJECT.md. 5 Ship check with check_secrets.py, check_live.py and the builder's own scans. If a fix breaks twice, roll back to the last save point. 6 Honest report: passed, problems worst first, left for later.
